question: Nongkrem festival of Meghalaya is celebrated by which of the following tribes?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Khasi tribe.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Nongkrem:-**

 
 
• **It is a popular harvest festival celebrated by the Khasi tribe in Meghalaya.**
 
• The festival is observed in the month of November and is dedicated to the Goddess Ka Blei Synshar for a good harvest and prosperity.
 
• During the festival, traditional dances are performed, and sacrifices are made to appease the deity.
 
• The festival is also an occasion for the Khasi people to showcase their culture and traditional attire.
